Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “give off their own light” in the K‑12/intro astronomy context (visible self-luminosity) and overgeneralized it to include any electromagnetic emission (e.g., infrared thermal radiation, auroras, comet fluorescence). This led them to choose D despite sources indicating that planets, moons, and comets are seen by reflected sunlight; only the Sun emits its own visible light.
